# Vera — Ship What You Meant, Not What You Wrote

> Vera is an autonomous AI engineering agent that turns feature requests into detailed specs, gets your sign-off, then ships the PR. Embedded in Slack, Linear, and GitHub.

Vera operates on a 5-stage lifecycle: Research, Prep/Plan, Execute, Review, and Triage. Her signature move is the spec-first workflow — she reads your request, researches the codebase, drafts a detailed specification, and gets your sign-off before writing a single line of code. After approval, she implements asynchronously and opens a pull request, so you ship what you meant, not what you wrote. Built by Vera AI, for engineering teams that ship fast.

## Product

- Name: Vera
- Category: AI Engineering Agent
- Platforms: Slack, Linear, GitHub
- Built by: Vera AI (Arsent LLC)

## Capabilities

- Research: Deep-dive codebase and web research for feature planning
- Prep/Plan: Draft detailed feature specs, break down tickets, validate sizing, get human sign-off before implementation
- Execute: Implement the approved spec, open PRs, write tests
- Review: Code review, resolve merge conflicts, keep CI green
- Triage: Investigate bugs, identify root cause, implement fixes

- [Feature Research & Implementation](https://agent-vera.com/#use-cases): Turn ideas into implementation-ready specs and merged PRs

## Differentiators

Vera occupies a unique position in the AI coding tools landscape:
- **Spec-first workflow**: Vera drafts a detailed feature spec and gets human sign-off before writing any code — you ship what you meant, not what you wrote.
- **vs. IDE copilots** (Cursor, Copilot): Vera is async — no IDE required, no babysitting needed.
- **vs. Standalone agents** (Devin): Vera is embedded in Slack/Linear/GitHub — no new workspace.
- **vs. CI/review bots** (CodeRabbit, Greptile): Full engineering lifecycle, not just code review.

Primary keywords: AI engineering agent, async AI engineer, AI coding agent Slack, autonomous coding agent, feature spec generation, requirements to PR, AI product specs, intent clarification agent, ship what you meant.
